caller_is_spender.meaning: transferFrom is invoked with an allowance so msg.sender (the caller) differs from the from-parameter token holder

event_from_address.meaning: address emitted as the first (from) argument of the ERC20 Transfer event by transferFrom
event_from_address.checkpoint: at Transfer event emission in transferFrom

actual_holder_address.meaning: the debited token holder address supplied as the from parameter of transferFrom

indexer_attributes_to_spender.meaning: off-chain indexers/explorers attribute the transfer to the approved spender (caller) rather than the actual token owner

assumptions: The caller is the approved spender by construction of transferFrom; no separate authorization check is at issue.
No direct on-chain loss of funds occurs; harm is ERC20 non-compliance breaking integrations.
The Transfer event's first argument is the observable that off-chain indexers use to attribute the transfer.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a concrete address value for the emitted from argument or the actual holder; the correspondence is formalized symbolically and must be bound to code at stage 3.

limitations: Formalizes only the indexer-attribution impact; other impacts (log misrepresentation, balance reconstruction, wallet history) are handled in separate passes.
The condition is the narrow transferFrom-with-allowance subcase the report establishes, not a general requirement over all transfers.
